text:
The man prevails. The right-of-way was an easement appurtenant that merger extinguished when the woman conveyed the house to him, uniting the dominant and servient estates in one owner, and a later sale of only the house does not revive an extinguished easement. The warranty deed created no new easement, and none arose by necessity or implication: the path was only a more direct route, and the man never possessed or used the house.

CONFIDENCE: 90
